annotations.title: Deterministic Edge DOM CSS Selector Scraper & Isolator

description: Evaluates CSS selector queries against HTML DOM trees to extract targeted inner text, outer HTML, or element attributes. Use when targeting specific elements like pricing badges, product titles, review cards, or navigation breadcrumbs; for parsing unstructured contact information, use extract_contact_info instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' and 'selector_query' ('extraction_mode' defaults to 'inner_text'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

extraction_mode.description: DOM extraction representation: text content, outer HTML snippet, or attribute key-value map.

html_content.description: HTML source markup to query against using CSS selector matching rules.

selector_query.description: CSS selector query expression (e.g., '.pricing-card', '#main h2', 'article p').

name: isolate_css_selectors

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for isolate_css_selectors.

elements.description: Extracted textual or markup contents of matched DOM elements.

matched_count.description: Number of DOM nodes matching the provided CSS selector query.

selector_used.description: Normalized CSS selector executed during edge DOM traversal.
